Name: weight_decay_sweep
Title: Weight Decay Drives Grokking Velocity on Modular Addition
Experiment: Sweep AdamW weight decay over {0.01, 0.1, 1.0, 3.0} while keeping everything else fixed. Report steps_to_val_90 and final val_acc per setting; fit a simple relation between weight decay and grokking onset.

Name: cosine_lr_schedule
Title: Cosine Learning-Rate Decay Accelerates Grokking on Modular Addition
Experiment: Replace the constant learning rate with a cosine schedule (with and without warmup). Compare steps_to_val_90 and final val_acc against the constant-LR baseline; also try a schedule that increases LR late in training.

Name: train_subset_size
Title: How Small Can the Training Subset Be Before Grokking Disappears?
Experiment: Vary TRAIN_FRACTION over {0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9} and track whether val_acc still takes off, and at what step. Identify the subset size below which grokking fails entirely within the step budget.
